title: Para Bellum content: models
description: A real vehicle or weapon. File: Content/<namespace>/model.json. A model belongs to one class, sets base values for any subset of that class's stats, and carries its materiel cost and production rate. A model is a DESIGN: it can be produced and stockpiled. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md section 3 in the game repository.

poolName.description: A resource pool name, listed in Content/vocabulary.json. Pools are fixed by the game's code.

name.description: Display name. Optional: a missing or blank name displays the id.

class.description: The class this model belongs to, by class id.

year.description: The year the model becomes available.

unlock.description: The research that unlocks this model, by id, or null if no research is needed. This is a DELIBERATE FORWARD REFERENCE, not an unfinished field: no research content type exists yet, so any non-null value is refused as a dangling reference (PB-C301) against type research. When research content is added, the same check starts resolving instead of failing.

supersedes.description: The model this one replaces, by id, or null. It must be a model of the SAME class, and the supersedes chain must not loop. A requirement for a class is filled newest-first along this chain.

stats.description: Base values for any subset of the class's stats. A stat you omit takes the class default. Whole numbers, never negative.

traits.description: Traits this model carries, by id. Each must be legal on the model's class.

cost.description: Materiel per unit produced, keyed by pool name. Whole numbers, never negative. Omit a pool to cost none of it.

production.description: The model's base production figures. It is an object, the same shape as a variant's production delta, so the two read alike.

units_per_factory_per_month.description: How many units one factory on a production line turns out per month at full efficiency.
